mapper.sql: select id, document_id, job_status, attempt_count, next_retry_time, started_time, finished_time, error_message from kb_index_job
mapper.insert: insert into kb_index_job ( document_id, job_status, attempt_count, next_retry_time, started_time, finished_time, error_message ) values ( #{documentId}, #{jobStatus}, #{attemptCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{startedTime}, #{finishedTime}, #{errorMessage} )
mapper.select: select id, document_id, job_status, attempt_count, next_retry_time, started_time, finished_time, error_message, create_time, update_time from kb_index_job where job_status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and attempt_count < 3 and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= sysdate()) order by id limit #{limit}
